{{Top|leg}}
'''Armor tallies''' were small [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] slugs that were part of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] armor. It contained the identification data of the clone who wore it. Many clones and non-clone members of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], like [[Kal Skirata]], collected the tallies from fallen troops during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
